title: DNA Extraction from Bacteriophages
author: Frej Larsen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzkup4ww
materials: Pipet 1 µL 100x diluted Pierce Universal Nuclease (2.5units/uL) to each well of a Qiagen S-block

steps.title: Transfer sample to S‑block
steps.instruction: Transfer 140 µL of each sample from the outer chamber of the CentrisArt filter tube to the S‑block and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Incubate 5 min at RT
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 5 minutes (00:05:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Add AVL buffer
steps.instruction: Add 540 µL AVL buffer to inactivate nucleases and lyse phage heads, then mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Incubate 10 min at RT
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10 minutes (00:10:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Add absolute ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 560 µL absolute ethanol and mix thoroughly by pipetting.

steps.title: Transfer to QIAamp plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 630 µL of the lysate to a QIAamp 96‑well plate, seal the plate with an AirPore tape sheet, and place the plate on a new S‑block.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Load the QIAamp plate on the S‑block into a rotor bucket and centrifuge at 5500 × g, 21 °C for 4 minutes or until all liquid has passed through the filter.

steps.title: Repeat loading until clear
steps.instruction: Repeat the loading of the plate onto the S‑block and centrifugation at 5500 × g, 21 °C until the entire sample has passed through the filter.

steps.title: Add AW1 wash
steps.instruction: Replace the bottom S‑block, add 500 µL AW1 wash buffer to each well, and reseal the QIAamp plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge AW1
steps.instruction: Load the sealed plate onto the S‑block in a rotor bucket and centrifuge at 5500 × g, 21 °C for 5 minutes or until all liquid has passed through the filter.

steps.title: Add AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Remove the seal, add 500 µL AW2 wash buffer to each well, and reseal the plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge AW2
steps.instruction: Load the plate onto the S‑block in a rotor bucket and centrifuge at 5500 × g, 21 °C for 5 minutes or until all liquid has passed through the filter.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Place the QIAamp plate on a new S‑block and centrifuge at 5500 × g, 21 °C for 10 minutes to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Discard the S‑block, place the QIAamp plate on an A&A receiving plate, and add 60 µL AVE elution buffer directly onto the filter membrane.

steps.title: Seal and incubate
steps.instruction: Seal the receiving plate with an AirPore tape sheet and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Load the receiving plate into a rotor bucket and centrifuge at 5500 × g, 21 °C for 4 minutes to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Store eluate
steps.instruction: Discard the QIAamp plate, seal the receiving plate, and store the eluate at –80 °C.
